gate.off_contract: no capture file, no stdout/stderr, no packet/estimator/RNG/plasma mutation
gate.on_contract: only the named capture file is added; transport state and RNG are read-only

header.fields: magic[8], endian:u32, version:u32, header_bytes:u32, record_bytes:u32, n_shells:u32, complete:u32, production_packet_count:u64, generation:u64, time_explosion:f64, delta_t:f64, segment_count:u64, shell_table_bytes:u64, reserved[48]

segment_record.fields: packet_id:u64, segment_id:u64, generation:u64, shell_id:i32, flags:u32, comoving_nu_start_hz:f64, comoving_nu_end_hz:f64, comoving_energy_start:f64, comoving_energy_end:f64, path_length_cm:f64, V_s_cm3:f64, delta_t_s:f64

flags.1: comoving endpoints with linear homologous trajectory

measure_contract: Both offline global J_nu and selective line Jbar consume these exact records with normalization 1/(4*pi*V_s*delta_t).
generation_contract: Every record generation equals the complete header generation; partial files are invalid.
prefix_contract: For a 2P capture, P is packet_id
